newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-MEDIQ Inc Q3 net income rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-MEDIQ Inc Q3 net income rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: -- Net income from continuing operations was $1.4 million or $0.05 a share after a charge of $11.04 million (net of taxes) for the repurchase of a warrant to acquire 10 percent of a subsidiary, the market appreciation and gain on the disposal of marketable securities of $6.08 million (net of taxes), and the gain relating to a note receivable of $1.16 million (net of taxes).

-- On a pro forma basis, MEDIQ's operating results reflecting cash proceeds were received from the sales of its investments in PCI NutraMax and the portable X-Ray business as of Oct 1, 1996 and used to reduce borrowings under its credit facility.
